heic2any 0.0.4 (https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2019 Alex Corvi.
It bundles libheif (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif), LGPL-3.0, compiled to JavaScript (libheif-js).
Loaded by app/media.js only when someone picks a HEIC/HEIF photo that the browser cannot open itself.
